title: 第9章 阴符宗第10章 负阴生阳
content_zh:
;;
苏白尘是第一个被叫上来的，自然也是第一个做选择的。
他不看玄阴真人那边，径直来到了无锋剑老处。
远处旁观的青锋寒简直人要麻了，这好像和说好的不一样啊？
“无锋师叔，弟子很感激寒师兄这些时日的悉心教导……只是，弟子看起来并不擅长剑法运用。”
无锋剑老沉着地点点头：“做你自己的选择吧。”
他怎么可能不知道苏白尘的情况呢？只是面子上抹不开罢了。
现在见苏白尘这样礼貌地给台阶，他心里头其实非常受用。
“纵然不入剑宗，你平日里也可以与剑宗门徒多交流心得，别荒废了你的长春剑气。”
苏白尘躬身应是并且道谢。
随后他才看向开阳真人道：“宫主，弟子受枫林子师兄引渡之恩，这些时日也多亏他教导，心里头敬仰得紧，只愿意入阴符宗修行。”
开阳真人和煦地捻须轻笑：“那就去拜见你往后的恩师，玄阴真人吧。”
苏白尘连忙对着玄阴真人恭敬下拜，而后郑重道：“拜见师父。”
玄阴真人扯出一抹笑容：“你很好，先站我身后，等回去了再安排你正式拜师。”
苏白尘这才高高兴兴地站到玄阴真人的身后。
他总算是松了一口气，三月前那剑拔弩张的情况令他很紧张，到此时他才算是放下了担心。
这些大佬吵不吵的他没关心，但别刮到他啊。
接下来的人有了苏白尘做参照，自然是有样学样。
众人纷纷感谢了这些天的授课老师或者引渡入道之人，然后才开始真正的选择。
一时间众人显得友爱有礼，氛围不要太好。

开阳真人也是满意地点头，觉得这一批弟子算是开了个好头。
他看苏白尘也是极为满意，不管将来如何，反正现在苏白尘就是这批弟子中最出众的那一个。
而这番表现也可以为剩下的外门弟子们好好打个样，让他们能够在接下来的生活中更有动力。
六名弟子，苏白尘进了阴符宗，王行远选择了剑宗。还有四人，三人选择了阳丹宗，最后一人则是入了五行宗。
这个比例并不出人意料，毕竟开阳真人还是宫主，在弟子资源方面总是能够占优的。
众人散去，苏白尘和王行远以眼神告别，然后就跟着玄阴真人往外走去。
他们看起来是要离开长春宫？
“这长春宫是阳宗以及阵器宗山门驻地，我阴符宗另有驻所。”
当然，距离也不远就是了。
说着他们已经来到了门口，正好与等候着的枫林子相遇。
“师兄！”
苏白尘开心地打招呼。
枫林子温和点头。
玄阴真人满意道：“枫林子是我最满意的弟子，而你是为师最有潜力的弟子，见你们相处融洽，吾心甚慰。”
苏白尘和枫林子连忙凑趣说两句，而后和玄阴真人一起来到了外头。
站在长春宫外，玄阴真人忽然念了一道口诀。
忽然就见天边来了一团烟气，落在苏白尘面前就化作一匹隐隐约约可见的龙马……其头生犄角背盖鳞片，一看就非凡物。

Su Baichen was the first to be called up, and naturally the first to make a choice.
He didn't look at Master Xuanyin and went straight to Wu Feng Jian's place.
Qing Fenghan, who was watching from a distance, felt numb. This seems to be different from what was promised?
"Uncle Wufeng, this disciple is very grateful to Senior Brother Han for his careful teaching these days... However, it seems that this disciple is not good at using swordsmanship."
Wu Feng Jian Lao nodded calmly: "Make your own choice."
How could he not know about Su Baichen's situation? It’s just that I can’t wipe it off in terms of face.
Now that he saw Su Baichen giving the steps politely, he felt very relieved.
"Even if you don't join the Sword Sect, you can still exchange more experiences with the Sword Sect's disciples on weekdays. Don't waste your Changchun Sword Qi."
Su Baichen bowed in response and thanked him.
Then he looked at Master Kaiyang and said: "Palace Master, this disciple has received the grace of being extradited by Senior Brother Feng Linzi. Thanks to his teachings these days, I have deep admiration in my heart and am only willing to enter the Yin Fu Sect to practice."
Master Kaiyang twirled his beard and smiled softly: "Then go and pay homage to your future mentor, Master Xuanyin."
Su Baichen quickly bowed respectfully to Master Xuanyin, and then solemnly said: "Meet Master."
Master Xuanyin smiled and said, "You're very good. Stand behind me for now. I'll arrange for you to formally become a disciple when you get back."
Su Baichen then happily stood behind Master Xuanyin.
He finally breathed a sigh of relief. The tense situation three months ago made him very nervous. Only now did he let go of his worries.
He doesn't care whether these big guys are noisy or not, but don't scratch him.
With Su Baichen as a reference, the next people will naturally follow suit.
Everyone thanked the teachers or those who had been extradited to Taoism these days, and then the real choice began.
For a while, everyone seemed friendly and polite, but the atmosphere was not too good.
Master Kaiyang also nodded with satisfaction, feeling that this group of disciples had made a good start.
He was also extremely satisfied with Su Baichen. No matter what happened in the future, Su Baichen was the most outstanding one among these disciples now.
And this performance can also serve as a good example for the remaining outer disciples, so that they can be more motivated in the next life.
Of the six disciples, Su Baichen entered the Yin Fu Sect, and Wang Xingyuan chose the Sword Sect. There were four others, three of them chose the Yang Dan Sect, and the last one entered the Five Elements Sect.
This ratio is not unexpected. After all, Master Kaiyang is still the master of the palace and always has an advantage in terms of disciple resources.
When everyone dispersed, Su Baichen and Wang Xingyuan said goodbye with their eyes, and then followed Master Xuanyin out.
It looks like they are leaving Changchun Palace?
"This Changchun Palace is the residence of the Yang Sect and the Mountain Gate of the Formation Equipment Sect. Our Yin Fu Sect has another residence."
Of course, the distance is not far.
With that said, they had arrived at the door and met Feng Linzi who was waiting.
"Brother!"
Su Baichen greeted happily.
Feng Linzi nodded gently.
Master Xuanyin said with satisfaction: "Feng Linzi is my most satisfied disciple, and you are the disciple with the most potential as a teacher. I am very relieved to see that you two get along well with each other."
Su Baichen and Feng Linzi hurriedly exchanged a few words, and then came outside with Master Xuanyin.
Standing outside Changchun Palace, Master Xuanyin suddenly recited a mantra.
Suddenly, a cloud of smoke was seen coming from the horizon. It landed in front of Su Baichen and turned into a vaguely visible dragon horse... It had horns on its head and covered its back with scales, which made it look extraordinary at first glance.
